description: Defines the FilterSourceStream class, a specialized SourceStream that reads from an upstream stream and applies filtering. Contains method declarations, private state management, and virtual methods for filtering data.

classes.name: FilterSourceStream
classes.description: A class representing a stream that reads from an upstream SourceStream and filters its data, with virtual methods for custom filtering logic.

methods.name: FilterSourceStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a source type and upstream SourceStream.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a buffer, implementing the SourceStream interface.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the stream.

methods.name: MayHaveMoreBytes
methods.description: Indicates if more bytes may be available.

methods.name: ParseEncodingType
methods.description: Static method to parse encoding type from string.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Internal method to manage state machine loop.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Virtual method to filter data, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the stream type.

methods.name: NeedMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if more input data is needed.
